g.text: Objective: log every event, write the two reports, and send today's alerts when there is a channel and something to say.

text.tspan: its events are in the events log
the events log keeps every event, so a same-day re-run appends the same events again
portfolio.md is written
profit and loss (P&L) and concentration are in it
P&L = market value − quantity × average cost; unpriced: P&L unknown
concentration weight = market value ÷ total of positions with a market value > 0; flagged above 15%
--history: P&L per snapshot; --concentration: the breakdown list
alerts.md is written
always written; an empty file when there are no events

g.text: the run ends with exit code 0, nothing sent
the run ends with exit code 0, alerts sent
the run ends with exit code 1, the send failed

text.tspan: Comes out:
reports/YYYY-MM-DD/portfolio.md, reports/YYYY-MM-DD/alerts.md, the alert message when sent, and the exit code
every event fired is appended to the events log
event_type, ticker, previous and current snapshot dates, details

g.text: portfolio.md is written with positions, profit and loss (P&L) and concentration

text.tspan: alerts.md lists today's events [a holding had an event]
today's events only: type, ticker, details

g.text: alerts.md is written empty [no holding had an event]

text.tspan: nothing is sent [no channel]
BOT_NOTIFIER is none

g.text: nothing is sent [a channel, but alerts.md is blank]

text.tspan: the alerts are sent by email or Telegram
[a channel, and alerts.md has text]
a same-day re-run sends the same alerts again
the send fails [email or Telegram error]
exit code 1
the run ends
exit code 0
the run ends
exit code 0
the run ends
exit code 1
